title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Extension of the Due-Back Time
content:
A Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement may be extended on the following conditions.

1. **Status.** A rental can be extended only while the agreement status is on rent, as the agreement record shows.
2. **Timing.** The extension must be requested no later than the due-back time. The due-back time on the agreement is compared to the moment of the request to the minute, with no grace (0 hours): a request at or before the due-back time qualifies, and equipment already past due cannot be extended and must be returned or billed as it stands.
3. **Length.** One extension adds no more than the class's extension limit in days, and the total period from checkout may not exceed the class's longest agreement period.
4. **Effect.** An extension changes only the due-back time; the time is billed at return under the rental time billing terms.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical due-back time Wednesday 17:00)

| Request registered | Agreement status | Extension |
|---|---|---|
| Wednesday 16:59 | on rent | may be made |
| Wednesday 17:00 | on rent | may be made (at the due-back time) |
| Wednesday 17:01 | on rent | not made; return or bill as it stands |
| Tuesday 10:00 | overdue | not made; the agreement is not on rent |

## Length check (hypothetical Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry agreement, checked out 1 March, longest period 56 days, extension limit 28 days)

- Extending a due-back of 15 March by 28 days to 12 April: 28 days added and 42 days in total; within both limits.
- Extending the same due-back by 30 days: more than 28 days in one extension; not within the limit.
